post-festival-detox-a-comprehensive-diet.title: Post-Festival Detox: A Comprehensive Diet Plan to Reset Your Body | Dietician Priyanka
post-festival-detox-a-comprehensive-diet.plain:
Diwali is different from other festivals because we don't fast instead we feast. All of us enjoy sweets and other favorite recipes on this big day, which is indispensable part of Diwali party. When we eat these food items, they releases free radicals also known as toxins which are very harmful for our cells and tissues. Indigestion, heartburn, bloating and heaviness are some of the common symptoms that you may experience after Diwali feast. So it is very important to neutralize these free radicals as soon as the festival is over. So, now its time for a detoxification .

Here I am sharing a post festival detox diet plan which will help you to feel lighter and energetic. This plan will also help you to reduce bloating and lose 1-2kg if you follow this plan for at least 2 days.

1.Drink warm lemon water - Start your day with warm water with few drops of lemon juice. Lemon juice helps to flush out toxins and unwanted food material present in digestive tract. After half an hour you can also drink 30-40ml amla juice also know as Indian goose berry which will boost up the detox process.

2. Take green juice - Green juice like dhania juice has diuretics properties which helps to reduce water retention and digestive discomfort like bloating and indigestion. You can add little rock salt for taste.

3. Eat two meal a day - It is better to have two meal a day instead of three large meals at 6 hour interval. This way you are giving sufficient time to your body to digest food, so that there is not undigested food items in your gut. Use whole cereals like barley, jowar, oats, bajra etc.. to make chapatis. You can have it with dal or cooked veggies of your choice. Chew your food properly and drink warm water after 30mins.

4. Eat fruits - Fruits contains digestive enzymes and helps to neutralize free radicals. So eat lots of fruits like guava, pear, pineapple, papaya, apple, oranges, keno in between meals.

5. Include probiotics - your detox process is incomplete without probiotics. Eating unhealthy diet increase bad bacteria in gut which causes unhealthy symptoms like gas, acidity or bloating. Eating probiotic rich food increase good bacteria in gut which helps to reverse the symptoms. Curd and apple cider vinegar is rich in probiotics. You can have curd or lassi without salt in between meals.

Apart from this light exercise like stretching, breathing exercises and kapalbhati pranayama is also essential for detoxification. Don't forget to walk for 10-15 min of walk after meals.

why-diabetics-should-include-potatoes-in.title: Why Diabetics Should Include Potatoes in Their Diet: Expert Insights from Dietician Priyanka
why-diabetics-should-include-potatoes-in.plain:
These days, social media is
providing us with lots of information about nutrition and health. But instead
of providing clarity, this information often creates confusion. Even qualified health professionals, trainers,
or experts who are not much focused on nutrition or don’t know much about food
and nutrition, are spreading misinformation about nutrition to the public,
adding to the confusion. Nutrition misinformation can lead to a fear of particular food for example potatoes. That's where we step in and and help you to put foods together in a healthful way.

Potatoes are staple food of
India, China, Russia, Europe and parts of the America for hundreds of years.
But these days its consumption has been reduced as it is perceived to be
associated with weight gain and other metabolic diseases like Type 2 Diabetes.

Although potatoes are rich is
starch most of it is resistance starch which has powerful health benefits. Resistant
starch is a special carbohydrate that resists digestion by your body. These undigested carbohydrate feed good bacteria present in large intestine and may improve
insulin resistance, which is one of an important cause of Type 2 Diabetes and PCOS.

Potatoes are good source of :-

1. Vitamin C which helps to boost our immunity.

2. Potassium which helps in reducing blood pressure and improve heart health.

3. Vitamin B6 which helps in development of normal brain function.

4. Fiber which helps in weight loss and improving insulin resistance.

Apart from this they are gluten free, helps to reduce inflammation, one of the most feeling food item and helps to enhance our mood. This makes it a better option than rice or pasta. Non of the studies has found potatoes to be associated with lifestyle diseases. I also include potatoes in my diet and diet of my clients and have helped them in weight loss and managing lifestyle diseases.

But what makes potato wees
unhealthy is its cooking method. Boiling cut potatoes causes leaching of
water-soluble vitamins and minerals like Potassium, Vitamin C, Vitamin B6 etc. Similarly
fried potatoes like French fries are found to be associated with Hypertension
and could increase the risk of Cardiovascular heart disease due to its high salt content.

So, you should always
refrigerate your potatoes after boiling for at least 6 hours or overnight to
enjoy its benefits. Cooling potatoes overnight after boiling triple their resistant
starch content. They can be included in the form of aloo chaat or mixed with other veggies for a healthful meal.

Boiling cut potatoes causes leaching of water-soluble vitamins and minerals like Potassium, Vitamin C, Vitamin B6 etc. Similarly fried potatoes like French fries are found to be associated with Hypertension and could increase the risk of Cardiovascular heart disease due to its high salt content.

So, you should always refrigerate your potatoes after boiling for at least 6 hours or overnight to enjoy its benefits. Cooling potatoes overnight after boiling triple their resistant starch content. They can be included in the form of aloo chaat or mixed with other veggies for a healthful meal.

reduce-blood-sugar-naturally-the-power-o.plain:
Type 2 Diabetes is a chronic metabolic disease. Continuous High blood sugar levels can seriously damage your vital organs including your eyes, nerves and kidney. But you can prevent and delay these complications by keeping your blood sugar in check.

These leaves have been scientifically proven to have antidiabetic properties that help to reduce your blood sugar without any side effects.

1. Mango leave s:

The scientific name of Mango is Magniferia Indica . Studies have found that mango leaves extract helps to decrease post meal blood glucose level by decreasing damage to beta cells of pancreas.

2. Curry leaves:

The scientific name of curry leaves is Murraya Koenii . Curry leaves are natural flavouring agents that enhances both taste and aroma. They are rich
in medicinal nutraceutical properties and are found to have blood glucose lowering properties. They also helps to protect your kidney from damage due to high blood sugar.

3. Peepal leaves:

The scientific name of peepal tree is Ficus carica . Its leaves possesses antidiabetic property by regenerating beta cells and stimulating the production of insulin.

4. Bael leaves:

The scientific name of bael is Aegle marmelos also wood apple. Its leaves are used as an Ayurvedic remedy for the treatment of diabetes. Studies have found 50% reduction in blood sugar on 12th day after continuous administration of bael leaves extract.

5. Guava leaves:

The scientific name of guava is Psidium guajava L., Myrtaceae. Its leaves posses a strong antioxidant and antidiabetic property. Studies have found that guava leaves extract can help to lower fasting blood sugar, total cholesterol, total triglycerides and creatinine. It can be also used as a functional food to protect liver, kidney, and pancreas damage.

How to use ?

Dry few leaves, makes its powder. Boil 1tbsp of dried leaves, boil it in water and drink it 30 min after meals. You can also use fresh leaves instead of dried leaves.

overcoming-depression-dietician-priyanka.title: Overcoming Depression: Dietician Priyanka’s Essential Diet to Beat Depression | Bite And Diet
overcoming-depression-dietician-priyanka.plain:
A healthy diet which includes sufficient amount of fiber, antioxidants, omega 3 and probiotics helps to beat depression

Mental health is an essential part of healthy life. A person who is physically fit and mentally strong can do anything in life. It is also important for learning and productivity.

We have found that excluding processed food and including sufficient amount of folic acid, magnesium, omega 3 fatty acids, fiber and antioxidants are associated with positive thinking and motivation. This is because 90 per cent of serotonin, a chemical that helps us feel happy also known as happy hormones, is made in our gut by our gut microbes. High intake of unhealthy food, refined food, processed food, food with added sugar and use of antibiotics leads to reduction in the number of these beneficial bacteria.

But when we include more probiotics in our diet like curd, yogurt and vinegar which contains good amount of healthy bacteria and feed them fiber their number increases. This leads to healthy gut and healthy mind.

It has been found that g lobally around 300 million people are suffering from depression which can lead to suicide, second leading cause of death . D epression and anxiety disorders are fastest growing mental health problems. Many times depressed patients need to take anti-depressant medications for a long time. These medicines have their own side effects like weight gain, tiredness, low sex drive, constipation, dizziness etc.

Therefore it is suggested that medical doctors and psychologists should refer depressed patients to a nutritionist or therapeutic dietitian as an important component of treating clinical depression.

Following changes in diet may help to beat Depression:

1. Increase the intake of vegetables, fruits, nuts, legumes, beans and healthy cooking oil in your diet.

2. Manage deficiencies specially magnesium, folic acid, and B vitamins. These nutrient deficiencies has been found to be associated with increased risk of depression.

3. Exclude or restrict the intake of processed foods such as sausages, packed fruit juices, soft drinks, sugar and food with added sugar to prevent depression .

increase-your-hemoglobin-levels-quick-an.title: Increase Your Hemoglobin Levels: Quick and Effective Tips by Dietician Priyanka
increase-your-hemoglobin-levels-quick-an.plain:
Human is evolved and nourished by food but the food we eat
is healthy or unhealthy depends on number of factors and one of them is cooking
utensils. This is because the material used for making utensils has the potential
to leach into the food being cooked.

These days most of us are using nonstick pans and coated
utensils which emit several harmful compounds which contaminate the food and
may cause cancer and other skin problems.

Traditionally earthen pots, cast iron, Brass and copper were
used for making utensils which increases the nutritive value of food. For
example cooking food in cast iron
utensil increases iron content of food. Iron helps in
the formation of
red blood cells. Iron also helps to increase energy level and is an essential mineral for maintaining healthy immunity. Iron deficiency can
lead to low hemoglobin level. The healthy
range for hemoglobin is 13.2 to 16.6 grams per deciliter for men and 11.6 to 15 grams per deciliter for women.

A study was conducted to find out the iron status of vegetarians
and it was found that Vegetarians have a high prevalence low hemoglobin level. So, it is especially important for them to
cook food in iron utensils to fulfill their requirement of iron. Cast
iron cookware is
versatile and may be
used for preparing dishes like baigan ki bhaji, lauki
ki sabzi, bhindi ki sabzi, chholey etc. They can be also used for deep fyring
and roasting. So next time when you are planning to buy new cook ware you must include cast iron utensil in your list.

top-anti-diabetic-foods-dietician-priyan.title: Top Anti-Diabetic Foods: Dietician Priyanka’s Guide to Eating Right for Diabetes | Bite And Diet
top-anti-diabetic-foods-dietician-priyan.plain:
Effects of various herbs and plants are reviewed for their anti-diabetic functions, including those traditionally used amongst many cultures for hundreds of years .

Common ones are:

1. Aloevera
2. Blueberry extract
3. Bitter melon
4. Cinnamon
5. Fenugreek
6. Ginger
7. Okra

Aloevera:

Aloevera may help to lower

Fasting blood glucose (FBG)

hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c), which shows the 3-month average of the amount of blood glucose attached to the hemoglobin in your red blood cells

Blueberry extract

Blueberries are rich in polyphenols, which include anthocyanin bioactive compounds. Epidemiological evidence indicates that incorporating blueberries into the diet may lower the danger of developing type 2 diabetes (T2DM)

Bitter melon

Bitter melon helps to lower blood glucose because it has properties that act like insulin, which helps bring glucose into the cells for energy. The consumption of bitter melon can also help your cells in utilizing glucose and move it to your liver, muscles, and fat.

Cinnamon

Several small studies have found that cinnamon helps to lower blood sugar levels by lowering insulin resistance.

In one study, volunteers ate about half a teaspoon of cinnamon for 40 days. The researchers found that cinnamon reduces cholesterol by about 18% and
blood sugar levels by 24%. You should avoid taking cinnamon if you have liver damage. Be careful If you have liver problems, because
large amounts of cinnamon may make them worse.

Fenugreek

Fenugreek seeds helps to improve most of the metabolic symptoms associated with both type 1 and type 2 diabetes by
lowering blood glucose levels and improving glucose tolerance.

Studies have found different results with different doses of fenugreek seed powder

100 grams of fenugreek seed powder to the daily diet
of patients with insulin-dependent or type 1 diabetes not only reduces fasting blood glucose level but also lowers total cholesterol and triglycerides.

15 grams of fenugreek seed powder into a meal eaten by people
with type 2 diabetes helps to reduce post-meal blood glucose.

2.5 grams of fenugreek twice a day for three
months lowered blood sugar levels in people with mild, but not severe, type 2
diabetes.

Ginger

Using about 4 grams of ginger per
day in your daily diet may help to lower your blood sugar levels and regulate insulin production. So even if you are taking medicines for diabetes you must include ginger in moderate amount in your daily diet.

Okra

Drinking “Okra or lady’s fingers water” is a quick and simple way to derive the benefits of okra without eating it.. The drink is prepared by soaking okra pods in water for 6-7 hours or overnight . Some of the valuable nutrients in the skin and seed pods will
be absorbed into the water.

You can also cut the okra
into thin slices instead of soaking the pods whole. Preparing okra water this way, may make the drink slightly bitter.

Okra peel You can prepare okra peel even at home by using a
handheld kitchen grater or a lemon zester. You can eat okra peel as much as you want, about half of a teaspoon of okra
peel is more than enough for your body to benefit.

Be sure to talk
to an expert before adding this to your treatment regimen. Together you can
determine the best dosage for you, as well as discuss any potential side
effects.

uncovering-the-truth-what-doctors-won-t-.title: Uncovering the Truth: What Doctors Won’t Tell You About High Blood Pressure | Dietician Priyanka
uncovering-the-truth-what-doctors-won-t-.plain:
Hypertension is a very severe health condition
and you'd never know without measuring your Blood Pressure. Unfortunately, this
may be a silent killer. If left neglected, it can severely damage your quality
of life and set the stage for heart condition, kidney complications, or a
stroke.

Medicines can effectively lower your blood
pressure. But the danger of long-term health consequences also depends on many
other factors like your current vital sign, cholesterol and blood glucose
levels. If these factors are not controlled you are likely to get heart attack
within the next ten years.

"Hypertension led to 1.63 million deaths in
India in the year 2016 alone and don’t think they are those who cannot afford medicines or good
hospital facility."

Our current thinking about treating high blood
pressure is misguided, and even harmful. Sadly, the drugs used for controlling
blood pressure can definitely increase our life expectancy but is not
successful in improving the quality of life.

How Bill Clinton was trapped by modern medical
science

If
a former president of the US, Bill Clinton who is one of the most powerful persons
in the world could become a victim of modern medical science, just imagine what
would be the fate of the commoner . Medicines taking for long can only lead to
future illness; this is very much evident from medical history of former US
president Mr. Bill Clinton.

After
getting four bypass surgeries when Bill Clinton was too sick from doctors and
medicines , he could reverse his heart disease by following a heart healthy
diet. By the top of 2011, he was healthy and young again. He could now travel
widely round the world.

"So, everyone has the right to decide for themselves whether or not to
take medicines for life time to lower their blood pressure. But before
deciding to take medicines for high blood pressure you must ask your doctor
about all the pros and cons of various treatment options ."

When interviewed by CNN regarding
his marvelous health recovery. He explained, “I went on essentially a
plant-based diet. I live on beans, legumes, vegetables, fruits. No dairy. I
drink almond milk mixed in with fruit when I start the day up. And it changed
my whole metabolism and I lost 24 pounds and I got back to basically what I
weighed in high school.

Side
effects of High Blood Pressure medicines

Medicines that lower blood pressure tend to
work well. But they don't necessarily treat the cause of the problem. And no matter how safe they are, all drugs can
have some unwanted or unintended side effects. Some common side effects of high
blood pressure medicines include:

Erection problems

Nervousness

Feeling tired,
weak, drowsy, or a lack of energy

Headache

Weight loss or gain without trying

So, instead of using only medicines for
reducing blood pressure, we should also try to find out what causes high blood
pressure in the first place.

Example of Mr. X & Mr. Y

I have a patient Mr. X, who is having high
Blood Pressure since 12 years. He decided to take Blood Pressure medicines and started
with one medicine/ day but now his dose has increased to 4 medicine/day and
still his Blood pressure is out of control. Along with this he also takes
medicines for his blood sugar & Cholesterol.

His vital organs are getting damaged now. His
eyes are getting damaged, uric acid and creatinine is also increasing which is
sign of kidney damage. Now Doctor
has advised him to control Blood Pressure through diet as they can’t increase
dose further.

I have another patient Mr.Y, who
is taking Blood pressure medicines since 10 years. He is not overweight
but still his Blood pressure is high. He
tried both allopathy and ayurvedic treatment but nothing worked for him.
Finally has decided not to use blood pressure medicines.

He has modified his lifestyle: He goes for
walk every day, eats a balanced diet and doesn't drink much alcohol. He feels
healthy now and doesn't want to have to take medicine every day. He tells himself: "If my blood pressure
suddenly goes up in a few years, I can still start taking medication then.

"No
treatment is successful without diet. If you decide to use food as a medicine
you don’t need to take medicines for long. Also you will be able to save your
vital organs from getting damaged."

When is medication necessary?

If your blood pressure is high for the first
time it can often be reduced by losing weight, healthy diet, taking natural or
herbal supplements, eating less salt and improving lifestyle. If that isn't
effective enough, treatment with antihypertensive medication is considered.

If you have very high blood pressure, the risk
of cardiovascular disease is so great that doctors usually recommend immediate
treatment with medication. This is the case for systolic blood pressure levels
over 180 mmHg.

Even if you are taking medicines don’t forget
to work on your diet and lifestyle which can not only help you to eliminate
your medicines but will also prevent your vital organs from getting damaged.

Uncovering the Truth: What Doctors Won’t Tell You About High Blood Pressure | Dietician Priyanka

Hypertension is a very severe health condition and you'd never know without measuring your Blood Pressure. Unfortunately, this may be a silent killer. If left neglected, it can severely damage your quality of life and set the stage for heart condition, kidney complications, or a stroke.

Medicines can effectively lower your blood pressure. But the danger of long-term health consequences also depends on many other factors like your current vital sign, cholesterol and blood glucose levels. If these factors are not controlled you are likely to get heart attack within the next ten years.

"Hypertension led to 1.63 million deaths in India in the year 2016 alone and don’t think they are those who cannot afford medicines or good hospital facility."

Our current thinking about treating high blood pressure is misguided, and even harmful. Sadly, the drugs used for controlling blood pressure can definitely increase our life expectancy but is not successful in improving the quality of life.

How Bill Clinton was trapped by modern medical science

If a former president of the US, Bill Clinton who is one of the most powerful persons in the world could become a victim of modern medical science, just imagine what would be the fate of the commoner . Medicines taking for long can only lead to future illness; this is very much evident from medical history of former US president Mr. Bill Clinton.

After getting four bypass surgeries when Bill Clinton was too sick from doctors and medicines , he could reverse his heart disease by following a heart healthy diet. By the top of 2011, he was healthy and young again. He could now travel widely round the world.

"So, everyone has the right to decide for themselves whether or not to take medicines for life time to lower their blood pressure. But before deciding to take medicines for high blood pressure you must ask your doctor about all the pros and cons of various treatment options ."

When interviewed by CNN regarding his marvelous health recovery. He explained, “I went on essentially a plant-based diet. I live on beans, legumes, vegetables, fruits. No dairy. I drink almond milk mixed in with fruit when I start the day up. And it changed my whole metabolism and I lost 24 pounds and I got back to basically what I weighed in high school.

Side effects of High Blood Pressure medicines

Medicines that lower blood pressure tend to work well. But they don't necessarily treat the cause of the problem. And no matter how safe they are, all drugs can have some unwanted or unintended side effects. Some common side effects of high blood pressure medicines include:

Erection problems

Nervousness

Feeling tired, weak, drowsy, or a lack of energy

Headache

Weight loss or gain without trying

So, instead of using only medicines for reducing blood pressure, we should also try to find out what causes high blood pressure in the first place.

Example of Mr. X & Mr. Y

I have a patient Mr. X, who is having high Blood Pressure since 12 years. He decided to take Blood Pressure medicines and started with one medicine/ day but now his dose has increased to 4 medicine/day and still his Blood pressure is out of control. Along with this he also takes medicines for his blood sugar & Cholesterol.

His vital organs are getting damaged now. His eyes are getting damaged, uric acid and creatinine is also increasing which is sign of kidney damage. Now Doctor has advised him to control Blood Pressure through diet as they can’t increase dose further.

I have another patient Mr.Y, who is taking Blood pressure medicines since 10 years. He is not overweight but still his Blood pressure is high. He tried both allopathy and ayurvedic treatment but nothing worked for him. Finally has decided not to use blood pressure medicines.

He has modified his lifestyle: He goes for walk every day, eats a balanced diet and doesn't drink much alcohol. He feels healthy now and doesn't want to have to take medicine every day. He tells himself: "If my blood pressure suddenly goes up in a few years, I can still start taking medication then.

"No treatment is successful without diet. If you decide to use food as a medicine you don’t need to take medicines for long. Also you will be able to save your vital organs from getting damaged."

When is medication necessary?

If your blood pressure is high for the first time it can often be reduced by losing weight, healthy diet, taking natural or herbal supplements, eating less salt and improving lifestyle. If that isn't effective enough, treatment with antihypertensive medication is considered.

If you have very high blood pressure, the risk of cardiovascular disease is so great that doctors usually recommend immediate treatment with medication. This is the case for systolic blood pressure levels over 180 mmHg.

Even if you are taking medicines don’t forget to work on your diet and lifestyle which can not only help you to eliminate your medicines but will also prevent your vital organs from getting damaged.

healthy-eating-tips-for-a-guilt-free-diw.title: Healthy Eating Tips for a Guilt-Free Diwali Celebration | Dietician Priyanka
healthy-eating-tips-for-a-guilt-free-diw.plain:
May the divine light of Diwali fill your life with health,
happiness and prosperity!

Like any other Indian festival, Diwali comes with lots
of mouthwatering irresistible dishes. Last
year most of us could not celebrate Diwali due to lockdown restrictions and tight
restrictions on household gatherings. This is also a lesson that, “Health is
Happiness”. So health is something which cannot be ignored at any cost…

We are here to help you to choose right food items during Diwali, so that you can enjoy this festival in a healthy smart way.

Want to look your best this shaadi season, register now and book
your first consultation. The first consultation is FREE!

https://www.biteanddiet.in/form

The trick is to stop overeating unhealthy food and use cooking
methods like steaming, grilling, baking etc. to prepare dishes. Some of the food
items that you can enjoy this Diwali are :-

1. Grilled vegetables :- Super healthy way to for snacking. Opt for vegetables like peppers, summer squash, onions, mushrooms, and corn to grill. Cut them into similar pieces and skewered, cook them all at the same rate. And when you slide them off the skewer, you get a mouthwatering mix of textures and flavors.

2. Zero oil dahi bhalla :- Ditch the normal dahi bhalle with steamed dahi bhalle this diwali. This is super soft and delicious and the same time very low in calories. So enjoy this super healthy gut friendly dish and keep yourself free from unhealthy gastric complaint like acidity, bloating, stomach distension etc.

3. Palak gatte ki sabzi :- Gatte Ki Sabzi which is a popular Rajasthani cuisine can be definitely served during festivals. Addition of palak in it makes it extra healthy and rich in folic acid. You can enjoy it with parathas and rotis for your main meal.

4. Mix vegetable :- You can use as many different vegetables you want to prepare this recipe. You can use cauliflower, cabbage, French beans, carrot, peas etc. to enjoy the nutritional benefit of each.

5. Cherry cheese pineapple stick :- Because it is Diwali and its celebration time ditch the boring cucumber salad with cheery, cheese pineapple stick. Very very easy to prepare and and irresistible.

Fresh pineapple when paired with cheese contains a proteolytic enzyme bromelain, which improves your digestion. Cherry is a sweet fruit that can be enjoyed even by diabetics and also helps to lower cholesterol.

6. Dry fruit ladoo :- Store-bought mithai tends are generlly over-sweet, high in fat and blended with maida & artificial flavours, so if possible, prepare sweets at home. This Dry fruit laddo is definitely going to satisfy your sweet cravings and at the same time very easy to prepare. Use whole foods like nuts and dates and enjoy guilt free. Of course portion control is important, you can eat 2-3 small ladoo.

7. Drinks:- Being on diet does not mean you cannot enjoy occasional drink.The key is to choose low-carb options. Avoid Beers as they arevery high in carbs. So choose wine or liquor when possible. Clear liquors like gin, vodka, whiskey and tequila are low in carbs.

prevent-urinary-tract-infections-with-th.title: Prevent Urinary Tract Infections with These Foods: Insights from Dietician Priyanka | Bite And Diet
prevent-urinary-tract-infections-with-th.plain:
Urinary
tract infections (UTIs) are among the most common infections especially in ladies.
However they’re usually treated with antibiotics, but repeated infection is
common. Plus, the overdose of antibiotics could result in negative health outcomes.
Some UTI symptoms include strong and constant urges to urinate, cloudy urine,
and a burning sensation while urinating.

But
If a UTI is untreated, it may spread to the kidneys, where the bacteria can get
into the bloodstream easily. This can lead to sepsis, the body's poisonous and
typically deadly response to infection.

If
you’re one among the various individuals within the world who experiences
recurrent UTIs, you must make few changes in your diet and practice healthy
habits. UTIs, or urinary tract infections, are not so difficult to control or
avoid with a balanced diet. In fact, your diet is usually the primary place you
must look at when trying to improve your overall health. Not only food, but
also the beverages you drink have a heavy influence on bladder health and UTI
contractions. It’s continuously suggested to require the assistance of
professional if you're treating it naturally.

Some food items that helps in preventing a UTI

Foods and drinks high in antioxidants and with a slight
acidic taste can help keep everything in check. These foods include
cranberries, blueberr ies, oranges, bittersweet chocolate or dark chocolate,
non-sweetened probiotic yogurt, tomatoes, broccoli and spinach.

Smart drink selection s are decaffeinated coffee; cranberry, blueberry, or pomegranate
juices; and black and green tea. Of course, lots of water is additionally essential when fighting off a UTI.

Blueberries:
Like cranberries, blueberries may additionally keep bacteria from attaching to
the tract lining. Add them to your salads or plain Greek yogurt, stir them into
smoothies.

Chamomile tea - Chamomile possesses a weak diuretic drug
result and contains plant compounds with medicinal properties

Ascorbic acid or Vitamin C: This could make the urine more acidic, which can
stop bacteria from growing. You can taking a supplement of 500 to 1,000 milligrams
of ascorbic acid or vitamin C daily, or get them from foods like oranges,
lemons, grapefruits, strawberries, blueberries, green leafy vegetables, and
green peppers.

Probiotics:
Probiotic food contains good bacteria. Some evidence suggests that probiotics
may help in preventing UTIs by preventing "bad" bacteria from growing
in the vagina. Probiotics are available in the form of supplements and in
fermented foods such as plain Curd, Greek yogurt, Cheese, Nimboo achaar &
Kanji

And
do try to prevent UTIs by staying hydrated. This is easy, you just need to
drink enough water so that you urine is almost clear in color.

Good bathroom and hygiene habits

Don’t hold pee for too long. This could result
in a buildup of bacterium, leading to infection.

Peeing after sexual intercourse may also
reduce the risk of spreading the infection and may help to prevent UTIs.

Avoid using spermicide, since it has been
linked to an increase in UTI.

When you use a toilet, you should always wipe
front to back. Wiping from back to front may cause bacteria to spread to the
urinary tract and is associated with an increased risk of UTIs.

Breathable cotton panties are less likely to
encourage bacterial growth near the urethra than nylon or other fabrics.

the-truth-about-fat-why-it-s-not-detrime.title: The Truth About Fat: Why It’s Not Detrimental to Your Health | Dietician Priyanka
the-truth-about-fat-why-it-s-not-detrime.plain:
Carbohydrate, Proteins and Fat are three major components of food items. Carbohydrates are essential food nutrients that our body breaks down to glucose which gives us energy. All cereals and milletes like wheat, rice, bajra, maize etc are rich source of carbohydrates. Carbohydrates are also found in fruits, roots and tubers like potato. Caroot, Beetroot etc..

Proteins are called building blocks. They are found in every part of our body like muscle, bone, skin, nails and hair etc. All our enzymes, hormones and hemoglobin that carries oxygen in your blood is made up of protein. Some of the protein rich food items include pulses, legumes, nuts, seeds, eggs, milk fish etc.

The third most important component of food item is Fat. They are also stored form of energy that our body uses during starvation. We need fat because it helps to absorb vitamins, like vitamins A, D, E, and K. Fat gives you more energy for longer duration as compared to carbohydrates and protein. 1g of carbohydrates and protein gives you 4cal of energy where as 1g of fat gives you 9 calories.

When we eat high protein and low carbohydrate diet, our body uses protein for energy purpose, this is known as Protein sparing effect and fat is again stored for future use. But when we eat high fat and low carbohydrate diet our body uses fat to give us energy. High fat diet also increases our metabolism as our body really needs to work hard to digest fat. So high fat diet leads to healthy weight loss where our body uses fat as a main source of energy.

You may wonder how much weight you can expect to lose in the first week of High fat diet. This shift, during which your body uses carbohydrate as a main source of energy and switch to using fat, usually takes 2-7 days. However, for some people, it may take longer.

Many people notice dramatic weight loss in the first week of high fat diet, but most of this is due water loss. However, once your body is used to it, it starts using its own stored fat for energy and you will lose weight rapidly. A large part of brain uses fat for energy, so consuming high fat diet also boosts your brain power.

So if you are looking for weight loss, high fat diet helps to lose weight quickly if followed in a healthy way. People who are involved in heavy exercises generally find it difficult to lose weight with a healthy balanced diet. But they may lose weight easily with high fat diet. High fat diet also have a positive effect on Diabetes, PCOS (Polycystic ovarian syndrome) and certain cancers.

But it should be noted that you should always follow high fat diet with the recommendation of an expert, to prevent its side effects.

The Truth About Fat: Why It’s Not Detrimental to Your Health | Dietician Priyanka

Carbohydrate, Proteins and Fat are three major components of food items. Carbohydrates are essential food nutrients that our body breaks down to glucose which gives us energy.
All cereals and milletes like wheat, rice, bajra, maize etc are rich source of carbohydrates. Carbohydrates are also found in fruits, roots and tubers like potato. Caroot, Beetroot etc..

Proteins are called building blocks. They are found in every part of our body like muscle, bone, skin, nails and hair etc. All our enzymes, hormones and hemoglobin that carries oxygen in your blood is made up of protein. Some of the protein rich food items include pulses, legumes, nuts, seeds, eggs, milk fish etc.

The third most important component of food item is Fat. They are also stored form of energy that our body uses during starvation. We need fat because it helps to absorb vitamins, like vitamins A, D, E, and K.
Fat gives you more energy for longer duration as compared to carbohydrates and protein. 1g of carbohydrates and protein gives you 4cal of energy where as 1g of fat gives you 9 calories.

When we eat high protein and low carbohydrate diet, our body uses protein for energy purpose, this is known as Protein sparing effect and fat is again stored for future use.
But when we eat high fat and low carbohydrate diet our body uses fat to give us energy. High fat diet also increases our metabolism as our body really needs to work hard to digest fat.
So high fat diet leads to healthy weight loss where our body uses fat as a main source of energy.

You may wonder how much weight you can expect to lose in the first week of High fat diet. This shift, during which your body uses carbohydrate as a main source of energy and switch to using fat, usually takes 2-7 days. However, for some people, it may take longer.

Many people notice dramatic weight loss in the first week of high fat diet, but most of this is due water loss. However, once your body is used to it, it starts using its own stored fat for energy and you will lose weight rapidly. A large part of brain uses fat for energy, so consuming high fat diet also boosts your brain power.

So if you are looking for weight loss, high fat diet helps to lose weight quickly if followed in a healthy way. People who are involved in heavy exercises generally find it difficult to lose weight with a healthy balanced diet.
But they may lose weight easily with high fat diet. High fat diet also have a positive effect on Diabetes, PCOS (Polycystic ovarian syndrome) and certain cancers.

But it should be noted that you should always follow high fat diet with the recommendation of an expert, to prevent its side effects.

vasa-haanikaarak-nahin-hai-dietician-pri.formatted:
Vasa haanikaarak nahin hai | Dietician Priyanka

कार्बोहाइड्रेट , प्रोटीन और वसा खाद्य पदार्थों के तीन प्रमुख घटक हैं। कार्बोहाइड्रेट आवश्यक खाद्य पोषक तत्व हैं जो हमारा शरीर ग्लूकोज में टूट जाता है जो हमें ऊर्जा देता है। सभी अनाज और बाजरा जैसे गेहूं , चावल , बाजरा , मक्का आदि कार्बोहाइड्रेट के समृद्ध स्रोत हैं। आलू जैसे फलों , जड़ों और कंदों में भी कार्बोहाइड्रेट पाया जाता है। गाजर , चुकंदर आदि ..

प्रोटीन को बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक्स कहा जाता है। वे हमारे शरीर के हर हिस्से में पाए जाते हैं जैसे मांसपेशियों , हड्डी , त्वचा , नाखून और बाल आदि। हमारे सभी एंजाइम , हार्मोन और हीमोग्लोबिन जो आपके रक्त में ऑक्सीजन ले जाते हैं , प्रोटीन से बने होते हैं। कुछ प्रोटीन युक्त खाद्य पदार्थों में दालें , फलियां , मेवा , बीज , अंडे , दूध की मछली आदि शामिल हैं।

खाद्य पदार्थ का तीसरा सबसे महत्वपूर्ण घटक वसा है। वे ऊर्जा का संग्रहित रूप भी हैं जिसका उपयोग हमारा शरीर भुखमरी के दौरान करता है। हमें वसा की आवश्यकता होती है क्योंकि यह विटामिन ए , डी , ई और के जैसे विटामिनों को अवशोषित करने में मदद करता है। वसा आपको कार्बोहाइड्रेट और प्रोटीन की तुलना में लंबी अवधि के लिए अधिक ऊर्जा देता है। 1 ग्राम कार्बोहाइड्रेट और प्रोटीन आपको 4 कैलोरी ऊर्जा देता है जबकि 1 ग्राम वसा आपको 9 कैलोरी देता है।

जब हम उच्च प्रोटीन और कम कार्बोहाइड्रेट आहार खाते हैं , तो हमारा शरीर ऊर्जा के उद्देश्य से प्रोटीन का उपयोग करता है , इसे प्रोटीन बख्शते प्रभाव के रूप में जाना जाता है और भविष्य में उपयोग के लिए वसा को फिर से संग्रहीत किया जाता है। लेकिन जब हम उच्च वसा और कम कार्बोहाइड्रेट वाले आहार खाते हैं तो हमारा शरीर वसा का उपयोग हमें ऊर्जा देने के लिए करता है। उच्च वसायुक्त आहार हमारे चयापचय को भी बढ़ाता है क्योंकि हमारे शरीर को वसा को पचाने के लिए वास्तव में कड़ी मेहनत करने की आवश्यकता होती है। तो उच्च वसा वाले आहार स्वस्थ वजन घटाने की ओर ले जाते हैं जहां हमारा शरीर ऊर्जा के मुख्य स्रोत के रूप में वसा का उपयोग करता है।

आपको आश्चर्य हो सकता है कि उच्च वसा और कम कार्बोहाइड्रेट वाले आहार के पहले सप्ताह में आप कितना वजन कम करने की उम्मीद कर सकते हैं। यह बदलाव , जिसके दौरान आपका शरीर ऊर्जा के मुख्य स्रोत के रूप में कार्बोहाइड्रेट का उपयोग करता है और वसा का उपयोग करने के लिए स्विच करता है , आमतौर पर 2-7 दिन लगते हैं। हालांकि , कुछ लोगों के लिए इसमें अधिक समय लग सकता है।

बहुत से लोग उच्च वसा वाले आहार के पहले सप्ताह में नाटकीय रूप से वजन घटाने को नोटिस करते हैं , लेकिन इनमें से अधिकांश पानी की कमी के कारण होता है। हालाँकि , एक बार जब आपका शरीर इसका अभ्यस्त हो जाता है , तो यह ऊर्जा के लिए अपने स्वयं के संग्रहित वसा का उपयोग करना शुरू कर देता है और आपका वजन तेजी से कम होगा। मस्तिष्क का एक बड़ा हिस्सा ऊर्जा के लिए वसा का उपयोग करता है , इसलिए उच्च वसा वाले आहार का सेवन आपके मस्तिष्क की शक्ति को भी बढ़ाता है।

इसलिए यदि आप वजन घटाने की तलाश में हैं , तो स्वस्थ तरीके से पालन करने पर उच्च वसायुक्त आहार जल्दी वजन कम करने में मदद करता है। जो लोग भारी व्यायाम में शामिल होते हैं , उन्हें आमतौर पर स्वस्थ संतुलित आहार के साथ वजन कम करना मुश्किल होता है। लेकिन वे उच्च वसा और कम कार्बोहाइड्रेट वाले आहार से आसानी से अपना वजन कम कर सकते हैं। उच्च वसा वाले आहार का मधुमेह , पीसीओएस ( पॉलीसिस्टिक ओवेरियन सिंड्रोम ) और कुछ कैंसर पर भी सकारात्मक प्रभाव पड़ता है।

लेकिन यह ध्यान दिया जाना चाहिए कि इसके दुष्प्रभावों को रोकने के लिए आपको हमेशा किसी विशेषज्ञ की सलाह से उच्च वसा वाले आहार का पालन करना चाहिए।

बाइट एंड डाइट में आपका स्वागत है,

हम भारत में अग्रणी व्यक्ति-पोषण विशेषज्ञ हैं। हम यहां "डाइटिंग की अवधारणा को मोड़ने" के लिए हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि आपको स्वस्थ रहने के लिए खुद को भूखा रखने की आवश्यकता नहीं है, आपको बस अपने लिए सही भोजन चुनने के लिए पर्याप्त स्मार्ट होने की आवश्यकता है।

हमारा मुख्य उद्देश्य पेशेवर परामर्श को सभी के लिए आसान, वहनीय और सुविधाजनक बनाना है। हम आपको पॉकेट-फ्रेंडली न्यूट्रिशन प्लान प्रदान करते हैं जो आपको बिना किसी साइड इफेक्ट के आपकी बीमारियों का प्रबंधन करने में मदद करेगा।

हम आपकी दवाओं की खुराक को कम करने या उन्हें खत्म करने में आपकी मदद करते हैं। इसका मतलब है कि आपको दवाइयाँ लेने की बिल्कुल भी ज़रूरत नहीं है - सर्द लगता है! हाँ लेकिन यह संभव है।

लेकिन फूला हुआ पेट और सुस्त त्वचा के साथ यह संभव नहीं है। आपका शरीर और विशेष रूप से त्वचा आपके द्वारा किए जाने वाले भोजन विकल्पों से बहुत प्रभावित होती है। आम तौर पर त्योहार के दौरान लोग तले हुए भोजन , मिठाई और वाइन परोसने के लिए अतिरिक्त उदार होते हैं। इससे उन्हें थकान , सुस्ती और भारीपन महसूस होता है। उनमें से ज्यादातर गैस्ट्रिक मुद्दों और सूजन के बारे में भी शिकायत करते हैं।

इसलिए , यदि आप अपने लहंगे और उन सभी साड़ियों में खूबसूरत दिखना चाहती हैं , तो आपके लिए शादी से पहले की देखभाल योजना का पालन करना बेहद जरूरी है। यह योजना उन दुल्हनों के रिश्तेदारों और दोस्तों के लिए भी फायदेमंद है जो अपना सर्वश्रेष्ठ दिखना चाहते हैं। यह सभी के लिए फायदेमंद है। यह योजना आपको केवल 2 सप्ताह में सपाट पेट और चमकदार त्वचा पाने में मदद करेगी।

आप क्रैश डाइटिंग और कुछ ऐसा ढूंढ रहे होंगे जो आपको तेजी से परिणाम दे। लेकिन याद रखें कि यह आपके लिए नहीं है क्योंकि यह आपको कुपोषित और सुस्त त्वचा के साथ छोड़ सकता है जो निश्चित रूप से आप नहीं चाहते हैं।

उच्च रक्तचाप एक बहुत ही गंभीर स्वास्थ्य स्थिति है और आप अपने रक्तचाप को मापे बिना कभी नहीं जान पाएंगे। दुर्भाग्य से , यह एक मूक हत्यारा हो सकता है। यदि उपेक्षित छोड़ दिया जाता है , तो यह आपके जीवन की गुणवत्ता को गंभीर रूप से नुकसान पहुंचा सकता है और हृदय की स्थिति , गुर्दे की जटिलताओं या स्ट्रोक के लिए मंच तैयार कर सकता है।

दवाएं आपके रक्तचाप को प्रभावी ढंग से कम कर सकती हैं। लेकिन दीर्घकालिक स्वास्थ्य परिणामों का खतरा आपके वर्तमान महत्वपूर्ण संकेत , कोलेस्ट्रॉल और रक्त शर्करा के स्तर जैसे कई अन्य कारकों पर भी निर्भर करता है। यदि इन कारकों को नियंत्रित नहीं किया गया तो आपको अगले दस वर्षों में दिल का दौरा पड़ने की संभावना है।

उच्च रक्तचाप के उपचार के बारे में हमारी वर्तमान सोच पथभ्रष्ट है , और हानिकारक भी। अफसोस की बात है कि रक्तचाप को नियंत्रित करने के लिए इस्तेमाल की जाने वाली दवाएं निश्चित रूप से हमारी जीवन प्रत्याशा को बढ़ा सकती हैं लेकिन जीवन की गुणवत्ता में सुधार करने में सफल नहीं होती हैं।

आधुनिक चिकित्सा विज्ञान में बिल क्लिंटन कैसे फंस गए ?

यदि अमेरिका के पूर्व राष्ट्रपति बिल क्लिंटन , जो दुनिया के सबसे शक्तिशाली व्यक्तियों में से एक हैं , आधुनिक चिकित्सा विज्ञान का शिकार हो सकते हैं , तो ज़रा सोचिए कि आम आदमी का भाग्य क्या होगा। लंबे समय तक लेने वाली दवाएं केवल भविष्य की बीमारी का कारण बन सकती हैं ; यह पूर्व अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति श्री बिल क्लिंटन के चिकित्सा इतिहास से बहुत स्पष्ट है।

चार बाईपास सर्जरी करवाने के बाद , जब बिल क्लिंटन डॉक्टरों और दवाओं से बहुत ज्यादा बीमार थे , तो वह एक स्वस्थ हृदय आहार का पालन करके अपने हृदय रोग को दूर कर सकते थे। 2011 के अंत तक , वह फिर से स्वस्थ और युवा था। वह अब दुनिया भर में व्यापक रूप से यात्रा कर सकता था।

" इसलिए , हर किसी को अपने रक्तचाप को कम करने के लिए जीवन भर दवाएं लेने या न लेने का फैसला करने का अधिकार है। लेकिन उच्च रक्तचाप के लिए दवाएं लेने का निर्णय लेने से पहले आपको अपने डॉक्टर से विभिन्न उपचार के सभी पेशेवरों और विपक्षों के बारे में पूछना चाहिए। विकल्प। "

जब सीएनएन द्वारा उनके अद्भुत स्वास्थ्य सुधार के बारे में साक्षात्कार किया गया। उन्होंने समझाया , " मैं अनिवार्य रूप से एक पौधे आधारित आहार पर चला गया। मैं सेम , फलियां , सब्जियां , फलों पर रहता हूं। कोई गोशाला नहीं। जब मैं दिन की शुरुआत करता हूं तो फलों के साथ बादाम का दूध पीता हूं। और इसने मेरे पूरे चयापचय को बदल दिया और मैंने 24 पाउंड खो दिए और मैं मूल रूप से वही मिला जो मैंने हाई स्कूल में तौला था।

मिस्टर एक्स और मिस्टर वाई का उदाहरण

मेरे पास मिस्टर एक्स का एक मरीज है , जिसे 12 साल से उच्च रक्तचाप है। उन्होंने रक्तचाप की दवाएँ लेने का फैसला किया और एक दवा / दिन के साथ शुरुआत की लेकिन अब उनकी खुराक बढ़कर 4 दवा / दिन हो गई है और फिर भी उनका रक्तचाप नियंत्रण से बाहर है। इसके साथ ही वह अपने ब्लड शुगर और कोलेस्ट्रॉल की दवाएं भी लेते हैं।

उनके महत्वपूर्ण अंग अब क्षतिग्रस्त हो रहे हैं। उनकी आंखें खराब हो रही हैं , यूरिक एसिड और क्रिएटिनिन भी बढ़ रहा है जो किडनी खराब होने का संकेत है। अब डॉक्टर ने उन्हें आहार के माध्यम से रक्तचाप को नियंत्रित करने की सलाह दी है क्योंकि वे खुराक को और नहीं बढ़ा सकते हैं।

मेरे पास एक और मरीज मिस्टर वाई है , जो 10 साल से ब्लड प्रेशर की दवा ले रहा है। उनका वजन ज्यादा नहीं है लेकिन फिर भी उनका ब्लड प्रेशर हाई है। उन्होंने एलोपैथी और आयुर्वेदिक उपचार दोनों की कोशिश की लेकिन उनके लिए कुछ भी काम नहीं आया। अंतत : ब्लड प्रेशर की दवाओं का इस्तेमाल नहीं करने का फैसला किया है।

उन्होंने अपनी जीवनशैली में बदलाव किया है : वह हर दिन टहलने जाते हैं , संतुलित आहार खाते हैं और ज्यादा शराब नहीं पीते हैं। वह अब स्वस्थ महसूस कर रहा है और वह हर दिन दवा नहीं लेना चाहता। वह खुद से कहता है : " अगर कुछ वर्षों में मेरा रक्तचाप अचानक बढ़ जाता है , तब भी मैं दवा लेना शुरू कर सकता हूँ।

" आहार के बिना कोई भी उपचार सफल नहीं होता है। यदि आप भोजन को दवा के रूप में उपयोग करने का निर्णय लेते हैं तो आपको लंबे समय तक दवा लेने की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है। साथ ही आप अपने महत्वपूर्ण अंगों को क्षतिग्रस्त होने से भी बचा पाएंगे। "

दवा कब आवश्यक है ?

यदि आपका रक्तचाप पहली बार उच्च है , तो इसे वजन कम करके , स्वस्थ आहार , प्राकृतिक या हर्बल सप्लीमेंट लेने , कम नमक खाने और जीवन शैली में सुधार करके इसे कम किया जा सकता है। यदि वह पर्याप्त प्रभावी नहीं है , तो उच्चरक्तचापरोधी दवा के साथ उपचार पर विचार किया जाता है।

यदि आपको बहुत उच्च रक्तचाप है , तो हृदय रोग का खतरा इतना अधिक है कि डॉक्टर आमतौर पर दवा के साथ तत्काल उपचार की सलाह देते हैं। 180 मिमीएचएचजी से अधिक सिस्टोलिक रक्तचाप के स्तर के लिए यह मामला है।

यहां तक कि अगर आप दवाएं ले रहे हैं तो अपने आहार और जीवन शैली पर काम करना न भूलें जो न केवल आपकी दवाओं को खत्म करने में आपकी मदद कर सकता है बल्कि आपके महत्वपूर्ण अंगों को क्षतिग्रस्त होने से भी रोकेगा।

बाइट एंड डाइट में आपका स्वागत है,

हम भारत में अग्रणी व्यक्ति-पोषण विशेषज्ञ हैं। हम यहां "डाइटिंग की अवधारणा को मोड़ने" के लिए हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि आपको स्वस्थ रहने के लिए खुद को भूखा रखने की आवश्यकता नहीं है, आपको बस अपने लिए सही भोजन चुनने के लिए पर्याप्त स्मार्ट होने की आवश्यकता है।

हमारा मुख्य उद्देश्य पेशेवर परामर्श को सभी के लिए आसान, वहनीय और सुविधाजनक बनाना है। हम आपको पॉकेट-फ्रेंडली न्यूट्रिशन प्लान प्रदान करते हैं जो आपको बिना किसी साइड इफेक्ट के आपकी बीमारियों का प्रबंधन करने में मदद करेगा।

हम आपकी दवाओं की खुराक को कम करने या उन्हें खत्म करने में आपकी मदद करते हैं। इसका मतलब है कि आपको दवाइयाँ लेने की बिल्कुल भी ज़रूरत नहीं है - सर्द लगता है! हाँ लेकिन यह संभव है।

लंच टाइमिंग वजन घटाने की प्रभावशीलता को प्रभावित करता है – अन्य जीवन शैली कारकों से , भोजन के सेवन का समय एकमात्र कारक है, जो वजन घटाने की प्रभावशीलता की भविष्यवाणी कर सकता था। यहां तक की बैरिएट्रिक सर्जरी के बाद पाया गया कि देर से दोपहर का भोजन करने वाले ( दोपहर 3 बजे के बाद ) सर्जरी के बाद शुरुआती खाने वालों की तुलना में कम शरीर का वजन कम हुआ।

देर से रात का खाना

अधिक वजन / मोटापे में 12 सप्ताह का प्रायोगिक यह पाया गया है जो लोग रात के खाने में ज्यादा
खाना खाते हैं, उन्हें इंसुलिन प्रतिरोध (insulin resistance) की अधिक समस्या है । इसलिए हम सभी को रात के खाने
के दौरान कम खाने की सलाह देते हैं और यह मेटाबोलिक सिंड्रोम (Metabolic sundrome)
के प्रबंधन के लिए भी उपयोगी है।

कैलोरी के प्रभाव पर पहले अध्ययनों से पता चला कि जो जो लोग नाश्ते में सबसे ज्यादा
और रात के खाने में सबसे कम कैलोरी का सेवन करते हैं वे अधिक तेजी से वजन कम करते हैंI
तो यह अनुशंसा की जाती है कि आप वजन कम करने के लिए उच्च कैलोरी वाले नाश्ते का सेवन करना चाहिए। जबकि नाश्ता छोड़ना अस्वास्थ्यकर व्यवहार से जुड़ा है , इससे कम ऊर्जा के साथ - साथ कोलेस्ट्रॉल और एलडीएल के स्तर में वृद्धिहो सकता हैI

अगर आप सही समय पर खाना नहीं खा रहे हैं , तो हो सकता है कि आप अपना वजन कम करने में सक्षम न हों I वजन पर नजर रखने वालों के लिए अपने भोजन के समय की योजना बनाना और भी आवश्यक है। यदि आप सही समय पर भोजन नहीं कर रहे हैं , तो आप अपने वजन घटाने के लक्ष्य तक नहीं पहुंच पाएंगे।

managing-uric-acid-levels-diet-recommend.plain:
Increased Uric Acid is an inflammatory condition . People with increased uric acid experiences severe attacks of pain, swelling and inflammation of the joints. This disease severely impacts quality of life as it make it difficult to walk and perform our regular house hold activities.

But the good news is that we have medicines.

Yes, and they are working effectively. Here point to be noted that medicines can only relieve some of the symptoms related to inflammation like reduction in pain but cannot treat its root cause. And what about its side effects??? Every medicine has its own side effects. On top of it it has to be taken for the whole life..

To make the condition worse there are so many myth related to diet for increased uric acid. One of the most common myth is that, "Don't take protein". So now, i am not allowed to take dals, milk, curd, eggs, fish, chicken, beans and almonds but what about my body. I have protein every where in my body, "Muscles, hairs, skin, hormones, enzymes, blood every thing is made up of protein. If I won't take protein how my body is going to perform its vital functions????

So, it is very important to have right information regarding dietary therapy to improve the symptoms of increased uric acid. As most of the doctors lack this information approaching a qualified dietician is highly recommended. A qualified dietician will give you complete information regarding diet and protein intake. Of course you can take proteins which are low in purine and in a measured amount. Some of the protein rich food items like walnuts, chia seeds, flax seeds are very rich in omega 3 which helps to reduce inflammation.

I have found in my practice that certain food consumption can bring a rapid change in your health due to their pro- or anti-inflammatory effects. In addition diet also helps to increase good bacteria in your gut which helps to reduce inflammation. So, on the basis of anti-inflammatory effect of different food items w e have designed a diet that not only helps to reduce uric acid but you will lose weight.

Yes, weight loss is very important because you r fat cells are very much responsible for increasing oxidative stress and inflammation. Weight loss is also important to reduce excess load on your knee. Anti inflammatory diet is so powerful that it can reduce the symptoms of swollen joints and stiffness within 3-4 weeks.

is-intermittent-fasting-safe-dietician-p.title: Is Intermittent Fasting Safe? Dietician Priyanka Discusses the Risks Involved | Bite And Diet
is-intermittent-fasting-safe-dietician-p.plain:
Most of us read
every day about intermittent fasting and try to follow it in our lifestyle. But
it may be dangerous if not followed in a right way. If intermittent fasting
followed in a right way then it is definitely going to help you in losing
weight, managing diabetes, reducing most of the gastric issues like excessive
acidity, bloating and a lot more.

Our
tradition lifestyle comprises only two large meal a day with minimum snaking –
one after sunrise and another before sunset. Most of the
research and studies has already proven the benefit of two meal pattern. This
is the best way of eating and when combined with intermittent fasting can give you amazing result.

Scientific reason behind intermittent fasting

To understand
this first of all we need to understand the role of insulin. You might have
heard lot about this hormone due to its important role in the development of
Diabetes and PCOS.

Food rich in
Carbohydrate like bread, rice, pasta, potato is broken down into sugar which is
used by our cells for energy purpose. But sugar can only enter our cells with the
help of insulin. So, if we are eating more carbohydrate rich food then our
insulin level increases.

Another
function of Insulin is to store fat and keep it there. So, more insulin means
more fat.

Increase in
carb intake = increased level of insulin = More fat deposition

So if you
don’t want those extra sugar and fat to be stored and want to lose weight your
insulin level should go down. When we don’t eat for long or starve, our insulin
levels reduces and then our cells can release their stored sugar, to be used as
energy. So, the whole idea of intermittent fasting is to reduce the level of
insulin. This also reduces fat storage in our body. In this way
intermittent fasting can not only help in weight loss but also in managing
Diabetes and PCOS.

How intermittent fasting can be dangerous?

Our metabolism
has adapted to daytime eating and nighttime sleep. That is why skipping
breakfast and nighttime eating reduces our metabolism which increases the risk
of obesity, as well as diabetes. This is where most of us go wrong.

But if you are
taking breakfast and lunch properly, your insulin sensitivity will increase and
this will help you to manage your diabetes and PCOS in an effective way.

Would you feel hungry ?

The best
time for intermittent fasting is 7am to 3 pm or 10 am to 6 pm depending on your rising hour. This basically includes your two main meals . You can snack within this eating hour window but stop
eating after 7 PM.

For best
effect, a void sugars and refined food during meal time and focus more on whole cereals, fruits, nuts, seeds, pulses and legumes. You can drink sugar free tea or coffee, lemon water,
vegetable juices if you feel hungry. The best part is that eating this way will reduce your appetite and you won’t starve.

Who should never do intermittent fasting?

Children's, Pregnant women, Lactating women and people those who are taking medicines should never do intermittent fasting. Still if you want to try you should always talk to your doctor so that your medicines can be adjusted accordingly.

Conclusion

Just by changing
the meal timings, by eating early and extending overnight fast time can help us
in improving metabolism, lowering blood sugar levels; reducing pain and inflammation.
When we fast our body also gets sufficient time to remove toxins and damaged
cells, which lowers risk for cancer.

smart-snacking-how-to-fill-nutrient-gaps.title: Smart Snacking: How to Fill Nutrient Gaps with Healthy Choices | Bite And Diet
smart-snacking-how-to-fill-nutrient-gaps.plain:
A few hours after last meal our stomachs start growling and that is why we need to have snack at least once a day. Sometimes we find a dip in our energy levels and a cup of tea or coffee can remedy.

Some of our most common snack choices are toast, sandwiches, biscuits, fruit juices, cookies, chips, ice cream, candy, popcorn, soft drinks, crackers, cake, milk, tea and coffee. Although snacks can be a regular and important part of a healthy diet, if not chosen carefully they can also lead to lots of health problems. So here I am sharing some of the healthy snacking options that will help you to fill the nutrient gap.

Before I start, would like to make you aware that having a cup of tea or coffee with added sugar is the most unhealthy thing that we an ever take. So you should always try to substitute your regular tea with green tea. Green tea is loaded with antioxidants that has number of health benefits. It help you to lose weight, and lower your risk of chronic diseases. You can have 2-4 cups of green tea in a day.

Some of the healthy snacking options are given below

1. Hare matar ki ghughni - Prepared by roasting green peas, one of the easiest protein rich and delicious snack can be taken any time of the day. They are also rich in fiber and magnesium. You can take one bowl of ghughni at a time.

2. Sattu water - One of my favorite bihari recipe. Sattu is prepared by roasting channa and making its powder. You can have it any time of they and it can also be used as post workout drink as they are rich in protein. Spice it with chopped onion, lemon juice, rock salt and mint cutney for a delicious summer drink.

3. Plain popcorns - They are the most popular snacks available everywhere. Since they are whole grain food, they are very high in fiber. Since its gluten free any one can have it. Avoid adding excess salt and butter for a heart healthy snack.

4. Shakarkandi chaat - Shakarkandi is rich in fiber and antioxidants specially beta carotene which is very good for improving vision. To make shakarkandi chaat just take some boiled sweet potatoes and spice it with lemon juice, rock salt and chaat masala. They are highly nutritious and filling.

5. Dhokla - One of the delicious protein rich snack. You can combine it with home made green chutney insted of tomato sauce to increase its nutritive value.

6. Mix nuts - Nuts like almonds, walnuts, pistachios, brazil nuts are an ideal nutritious snack which gives perfect balance of protein, fiber and good fat. Brazil nuts are one of the richest source of Selenium (selenium is needed for healthy thyroid function). Be careful about the portion size, and aim to stick to about 1 handful of nuts in a day.

7. Curd with pomegranate - Curd is best probiotic food and combining it with fruit like pomegranate makes it rich in antioxidants too. They are great choice for those suffering with heart problems like high blood pressure, high cholesterol etc..

8. D ark chocolate with nuts - Dark chocolate contains antioxidants, and nuts are a rich source of good fats . The two make a great combo for a crunchy, heart-healthy and satisfying snack. Again b e careful about the portion size, you can have a square of dark chocolate with a handful of nuts.

9. Carrot and cucumber slices with hummus - You can prepare hummus at home. They basically include chickpeas, tahini, olive oil, and garlic which provide a mix of plant-based protein, fiber, and heart healthy good fat. You can have 2tbsp of hummus with 1 bowl of carrot and cucumber slices.

10. Fruits - If you are looking for something simple, nutritious and one of the healthiest food on earth fruits can be a great choice. You can choose any seasonal fruit like apples, pears, grapes, guava, jamun, bael, mango and oranges.

11. Chia pudding - Chia seeds are nutritional powerhouses loaded with fiber, omega-3 fatty acids, and proteins. To make chia pudding you can simply soak 2tbsp of chia seeds in a cup of curd for 30 min. To make it more nutritious and satisfying you can top it with fruits and nuts.

12. Makhanna chaat - Makhanna is rich in calcium, magnesium, iron and antioxidants. This make it an ideal choice for healthy heart , blood sugar management, and weight loss. Combining it with curd, green chutney and pomegranate increases its nutritive value.

13. Gur channa - They are great choice for those who are anemic or have iron deficiency. you can have 1 handful of channa with 2tbsp of gur in a day.

14. Sprouts - Lentils are rich source of protein, fiber and vitamin - B. Sprouting them increases its Vit- C content. You can mix chopped tomatoes and pomegranate to it for a healthful snacking.

15. Sweet corn chaat - If you are looking for something junk and spicy corn chaat is great choice. They are gluten free and rich in fiber which makes it a healthy and tasty option over any junk food.

winter-detox-made-easy-nourishing-recipe.title: Winter Detox Made Easy: Nourishing Recipes from Dietician Priyanka | Bite And Diet
winter-detox-made-easy-nourishing-recipe.plain:
These days due to the
increased exposure to pollution, preservatives and pesticides we are
accumulating lots of toxins in our body. These toxins are very harmful for our health. They may lead
to gastric health issues, metabolic diseases, fertility problem, skin problems,
respiratory problems, weak immunity and cancer . Therefore it is very important
to detox yourself on a regular basis.

Detox water
is not limited to fruits and vegetable infused water but it is much more than
that. We can prepare this detox water in a number of ways. Here I am sharing five detox recipes that you
can easily prepare at home. To get more benefit always drink this as a
first thing in the morning.

1. Haldi Tea

To prepare this tea add
equal amount of haldi and ginger to boiling water and boil it till it become
half. You can also add a pinch of black pepper as it increase the absorption of curcumin. Once it cools down
add 1tsp of honey and your haldi tea is ready. Haldi,
a spice that has long been recognized for its medicinal properties is rich in
antioxidants, helps to reduce anxiety, inflammation and arthritis pain. It also
helps to reduce exercise-induced muscle soreness. Therefore it is perfect
recipe for winter detox.

2. Ginger Detox tea

To prepare this
recipe Boil the water with grated ginger. Strain it, once cool down but not
completely add lemon juice and pink salt. This ginger tea helps to reduce digestive
complain, pain and inflammation during winter.

3. Orange and carrot Smoothie

To prepare
this juice blend 2-3 Carrots, juice or 2 oranges, 2tsp of ginger and 1 ½ tsp of
turmeric and blend it. This detox juice
is filled with essential vitamins which makes it perfect for flushing out
toxins and retaining energy for the day.

4 . Dhania smoothie

To prepare this
smoothie first of all you need to prepare dhania chutney. Take 2tbsp of this
chutney, add jeera powder, lemon juice and black salt for taste. Dhania has
lots of bioactive compound that has its own medicinal value. This juice helps
to manage diabetes, reduce inflammation and has diuretic properties which makes
it perfect drink to start your day.

5. Amla juice

To make this juice chop
amla roughly, combine it with chopped ginger and little water in a mixer jar
and blend. Strain the juice. You can add little pink salt for taste and your
juice is ready. Amla possess chemopreventive effects, rich in Vitamin C, antioxidants,
anti-inflammatory properties. Amla also helps in prevention and treatment of
cancer.

strategies-for-healthy-weight-gain-top-t.title: Strategies for Healthy Weight Gain: Top Tips from Dietician Priyanka | Bite And Diet
strategies-for-healthy-weight-gain-top-t.plain:
Most of the people are either overweight or obese . However, there are also many people who are too skinny and want to gain weight . It important because if you are underweight you may have

- Low energy and stamina

- weak immunity

- Low self esteem

There are many reasons why a person may be underweight. Some of them are:

-> High physical activity - If you are doing high level of physical activity like running or heavy exercise, your nutrients requirement may increase. You need more calories, proteins and vitamins to fulfill those requirement and if you are not doing so, you may lose your muscles.

-> Chronic Diseases - Some of the chronic diseases like Irritable Bowel Syndrome may lead to weight loss and nutrient deficiencies.

-> Stress and Anxiety - Poor mental status may affect a person ability to eat and may lead to weight loss.

-> Infectious Diseases - Infectious diseases like COVID , Typhoid , Jaundice etc. may lead to excess loss of muscles.

-> Genetics - Some may be underweight because it runs in your family.

Apart from Genetics, healthy weight gain is important for all four causes. A person can gain weight by following a healthy diet that includes nutritious calorie-dense foods. A Dietician can help you to develop a diet plan that help you to manage your deficiencies and fulfill your requirement of calories, proteins and vitamins. Here i am sharing some of the tips to gain weight :-

-> Include high protein snacks - High protein snacks like Almonds, Peanuts, Pumpkin seeds, Curd along with fruits will help you to fulfill the requirement of proteins, vitamins and minerals.

-> Add smoothies to your diet - Smoothies are complete meal. You can take it any time of the day. You can try Banana smoothie, Mango smoothie, Chiku smoothie if you want to gain weight.

-> Don't forget to add salads to your meals - Don't think that salads are only for those who want to lose weight. If you are not taking salads you may develop constipation. You can try high protein salads like sprouts salad, Paneer salad, peanut salad to fulfill your requirement of fiber and protein.

-> Eat easily digestible food - Food that are easy to digest like potatoes, sabudana, curd, Fruits or Fruit juices may help you to gain weight quickly. Avoid fried food as they are difficult to digest and make you feel bloated.

-> Exercise - Light exercise is important even if you want to gain weight. 15-20 mins of Exercise like walking, yoga or weight training may help to improve your apetite, reduce stress and gain muscles.

When to see a Dietician?

A person should approach a qualified Dietician if they have been trying to gain weight but unable to do so. Anyone who is experiencing medical problem like Irritable bowel Syndrome or lost weight due to infectious diseases like COVID, Typhoid, Jaundice etc. should also see a dietician to gain healthy weight.
If a person is unable to manage their stress and anxiety, it is essential to look for professional help.

Strategies for Healthy Weight Gain: Top Tips from Dietician Priyanka | Bite And Diet

Most of the people are either overweight or obese . However, there are also many people who are too skinny and want to gain weight . It important because if you are underweight you may have

- Low energy and stamina
- weak immunity
- Low self esteem

There are many reasons why a person may be underweight. Some of them are:

- High physical activity - If you are doing high level of physical activity like running or heavy exercise, your nutrients requirement may increase. You need more calories, proteins and vitamins to fulfill those requirement and if you are not doing so, you may lose your muscles.
- Chronic Diseases - Some of the chronic diseases like Irritable Bowel Syndrome may lead to weight loss and nutrient deficiencies.
- Stress and Anxiety - Poor mental status may affect a person ability to eat and may lead to weight loss.
- Infectious Diseases - Infectious diseases like COVID , Typhoid , Jaundice etc. may lead to excess loss of muscles.
- Genetics - Some may be underweight because it runs in your family.

Apart from Genetics, healthy weight gain is important for all four causes. A person can gain weight by following a healthy diet that includes nutritious calorie-dense foods.
A Dietician can help you to develop a diet plan that help you to manage your deficiencies and fulfill your requirement of calories, proteins and vitamins. Here i am sharing some of the tips to gain weight :-

- Include high protein snacks - High protein snacks like Almonds, Peanuts, Pumpkin seeds, Curd along with fruits will help you to fulfill the requirement of proteins, vitamins and minerals.
- Add smoothies to your diet - Smoothies are complete meal. You can take it any time of the day. You can try Banana smoothie, Mango smoothie, Chiku smoothie if you want to gain weight.
- Don't forget to add salads to your meals - Don't think that salads are only for those who want to lose weight. If you are not taking salads you may develop constipation. You can try high protein salads like sprouts salad, Paneer salad, peanut salad to fulfill your requirement of fiber and protein.
- Eat easily digestible food - Food that are easy to digest like potatoes, sabudana, curd, Fruits or Fruit juices may help you to gain weight quickly. Avoid fried food as they are difficult to digest and make you feel bloated.
- Exercise - Light exercise is important even if you want to gain weight. 15-20 mins of Exercise like walking, yoga or weight training may help to improve your apetite, reduce stress and gain muscles.

When to see a Dietician?

A person should approach a qualified Dietician if they have been trying to gain weight but unable to do so.
Anyone who is experiencing medical problem like Irritable bowel Syndrome or lost weight due to infectious diseases like COVID, Typhoid, Jaundice etc. should also see a dietician to gain healthy weight.
If a person is unable to manage their stress and anxiety, it is essential to look for professional help.

inspiring-transformation-how-mr-avinas-l.title: Inspiring Transformation: How Mr. Avinas Lost 10 Kilos in Just 8 Weeks | Dietician Priyanka
inspiring-transformation-how-mr-avinas-l.plain:
Mr.Avinas had to lose lose weight to be medically fit for his job. This was not an
easy task as he had only 2 months to achieve the target.

He
is physically very active, used to do suryanamaskaar and other yogasans for
about 2 hours in a day. He believes that Suryanamaskaar is his lifeline. I
agree because his all health parameters were very good and his haemoglobin is
15g/dl, which is too good.

But
only challenge was that he gained few kilos and this made him medically unfit
for his job. He
was already following a diet to lose weight and this made him weak. He started
becoming stressed and could not continue the diet further.

This made him to
search for an expert who could help him and he called me. We
quickly enrolled him in the plan as we had very few days left. But since he was
feeling very weak I told him to eat proper meals for 2-3 days so that he could
regain all his energy and start the plan.

Note-
Following crash diet may drain all your energy and stamina which will reduce
your metabolism. Slow metabolism makes it difficult to lose weight. So, always
try to lose weight with the help of an expert or a dietician.

I must say that he followed
the plan very religiously and was able to lose around 10Kilos in 8 weeks without
losing his energy and stamina.

Some of the challenges faced
by him:-

·
Limited time

·
Excessive weakness

·
No one was there to cook food for him

·
He had to manage his job and diet both

·
Occasional travelling

Despite all these challenges
he could succeed to be medically fit for his job before our set time, yes,
before set time.

At the end
we can say that weight loss is not difficult for those who have strong will
power and motivation. And don’t forget right guidance.

misinformation about nutrition to the public, adding to the confusion.

Today, with all of these
misinformation people are unhealthy than ever. This is where we come in – we
tell you the truth and provide you Pocket friendly Nutrition Plans which will help you to not only in managing weight but
also chronic diseases without any side effects .

enhance-your-sleep-quality-essential-nut.title: Enhance Your Sleep Quality: Essential Nutrition Tips from Dietician Priyanka | Bite And Diet
enhance-your-sleep-quality-essential-nut.plain:
Most of us are unable to enjoy 8 hours of sound sleep at night—a trend that can lead to serious health issues. Sleep deprivation increases the risk of lifestyle diseases including obesity, diabetes, PCOS and heart disease. Medicines which are prescribed for sleep may help with
falling asleep initially, but tend to reduce the amount of deeper sleep. If
taken for long time can worsen sleep quality and increase depression. They are
also associated with increased risk of cancer.

So, it is better to improve your diet and lifestyle first before going for any kind of medicinal treatment. Nutrition Therapy to improve sleep quality is possible, convenient and inexpensive strategy. If you have trouble sleeping, the following nutrients are definitely going to help you.

To know more about us kindly visit our website: https://biteanddiet.in/

1. High fiber food - A connection has been found between gut health and our mood. Good bacteria keeps our gut healthy. Food rich in fiber like Whole cereals, Lentils, raw vegetables, fruits etc.. feed our gut healthy bacteria. So, you should include more of high fiber food like oats, ragi, sprouts, fruits etc.. in your diet if you are unable to sleep well.

2. Probiotics - Another way of improving gut health is to include more probiotics in your diet. Some of the Indian food items rich in probiotics include curd, buttermilk, kanji, pickles with vinegar etc. Include them in a number of ways and see the difference.

3. Omega 3 fatty acids - Numerous studies has shown that people who eat fish at least thrice a week enjoy a better sleep quality. If you don't eat fish you can pop omega 3 capsules, that will also give you the same benefit. Some vegetarian sources of omega 3 include flaxseeds, chia seeds and walnuts.

4. Tryptophan rich food - Tryptophan is required to maintain high quality sleep. Tryptophan is generally found in food items which are rich in protein eg. milk, cheese, peanuts, pumpkin and sesame seeds, tofu and soya. So, you must include more protein food in your diet to enjoy a better sleep quality.

5. Food rich in Gama - Aminobutyric acid (GABA) - Numerous studies has shown beneficial affect of Gama- Aminobutyric acid in improving sleep quality. Food rich in GABA include Spinach, potato, sweet potato, broccoli and mushrooms.

6. Vitamin D - Vitamin D deficiency leads to poor quality sleep. So, it is important to manage Vitamin D deficiency in order to improve sleep quality. Vitamin D is also know as sunshine vitamin, So exposing yourself to sunlight for 15-20 min daily without SPF helps to fulfill its deficiency. Fatty fish are major source of vitamin D. Mushrooms are the only vegetarian source of Vitamin D.

Apart from this stress also need to be managed in order to improve sleep quality. Herbal supplements like Ashwagandha may help to reduce the level of stress hormones like cortisol in your body.
